subject: 桑耶寺 · 乌策大殿正面（现状，三层金顶）
name: 桑耶寺
sub: 乌策大殿正面 · 吐蕃创建 · 现状重建
era: 8世纪创建 · 乌策大殿现状
yearNote: 《巴协》载762年赤松德赞奠基、775年落成；寺前石碑为779年赤松德赞兴佛盟誓，首批藏人同年在此剃度；国保名单记787～799年。图版绘乌策大殿现状：大殿上部在文化大革命中被拆毁，1986年起修复、1988年后重建，金顶与上层为重建面貌。年表取779年作吐蕃创建期的约略定位。
place: 西藏 · 山南 · 扎囊
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q1430211（桑耶寺）P625 坐标 29.32644, 91.50422，寺院本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_samye。
lede: 779年，首批藏人在这里剃度出家，桑耶寺成为吐蕃第一座僧团俱全的寺院。乌策大殿立在寺院正中，底层藏式、中层汉式、上层印度式，三种营造叠成一殿，外观似五层、内部实为三层。今天看到的金顶与上层，是文革拆毁后于1980年代末重建的样子。
facts: 年代：《巴协》载762年赤松德赞奠基、775年落成，寂护设计、莲花生主持；寺前石碑记779年兴佛盟誓；1996年列第四批国保。
形制：乌策大殿坐西朝东，外观似五层、内部实为三层，每层高5.5—6米；底层藏式、中层汉式、上层印度风格，总面积约8900平方米。
重建：大殿上部在文化大革命中被拆毁，1986年起在十世班禅推动下修复，1988年后重建，现存金顶与上层为重建面貌。
caption: 桑耶寺 · 乌策大殿正面
吐蕃创建 · 现状重建
structure_checkpoints: 正面自下而上：白色石砌一层长墙，窗为黑色梯形窗套、金色格栅、橙红色短帘，正面可见左三右四共七窗（两端被画幅截断，墙体更长）；墙顶为赭红色边玛墙带（白点饰），再上一道白色压顶。
中央入口：一座两层木构门廊凸出墙面，上层为木格栅窗廊配白色流苏帘，下层悬黑底白纹门帘（吉祥结、法轮、吉祥结、海螺），帘下为深色木门洞；门廊顶上立一根彩条经幡柱。
一层之上退后升起金顶层：一座大型鎏金汉式屋面（四角起翘、角端兽头）覆盖带鎏金板与栏杆的回廊层；其上再升一座中央鎏金小殿顶配高大宝瓶刹，左右各一座方形小塔楼，塔身嵌绿色琉璃板饰十字金刚杵纹、顶上鎏金刹——正面共三个刹，中央最高。
白墙两端的屋顶各立一座黑白蓝条纹的宝幢圆筒（右端另有一根金色经幢）；全殿为平顶藏式殿身托汉式金顶，不要画成通体坡屋顶。
material_observations: 下层墙面白色石砌抹灰、略见砌缝；边玛墙带赭红、白点；窗套黑色、格栅金黄、窗帘橙红；门帘黑底白纹；金顶与栏板鎏金铜，侧塔楼嵌墨绿琉璃板；宝幢黑白蓝条纹布；地面为灰色石板路与土地。
author: Gerd Eichmann

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Utse (central main temple) of Samye Monastery, Shannan, Tibet, drawn from the straight-on front view of Image 2; Image 3 is an oblique view used only to understand how the roof tiers step back. Draw the complete front: a long whitewashed ground-floor wall with SEVEN visible trapezoid-framed lattice windows (three left, four right of the entrance), each with a short fringed valance; a deep dark parapet band along the top of the wall. In the centre a two-storey timber entrance porch projects from the wall: lattice window gallery above, a broad banner with four simple emblem outlines (knot, wheel, knot, conch) hanging over the dark doorway below. Behind and above the wall rise the gilded roof tiers: first a wide hip-style gilded roof with upturned corners sheltering a gallery of gilt panels and railings, then a central crowning pavilion roof with a tall vase finial flanked by two square tower-like roof pavilions with their own finials, so THREE finials rise above the roof, the central one highest. Put one cylindrical banner finial at each end of the lower roofline. The lower body is a flat-roofed Tibetan block; only the upper tiers carry Chinese-style sloping gilded roofs — do not cover the whole hall with a pitched roof. Remove the tree, the prayer pole, visitors, paving pattern and sky.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
